detail.longDescription: I've been wondering if there was any point in renewing my PhpStorm subscription this year. The quality of the product feels like it's taken a nosedive. Looking into other options atm and Zed is looking pretty good so far. I'll have to try it out as my daily driver and see how it goes though. My PhpStorm license is still good for another month or so at least. # php # webdev # phpstorm
